components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"

      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true

      title: Specialty

      properties:

          description: The ID of the specialty.

          format: int32

          example: 1
          readOnly: true

          type: string

          example: radiology
      required:

          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9 ()-]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Defaults to today when not supplied.
          type: string
          format: date

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true

## Summary

I implemented the `namesakeCount` field, which reports how many other owners shared the owner's last name at the moment of registration.

Changes made, following the existing pattern used for `membershipNumber`/`customerCode`/`membershipTier`:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added the `namesakeCount` property (integer, `int32`, `minimum: 0`, `readOnly`) to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` gets a `setNamesakeCount`.

2. **`OwnerMapper.java`** — added a `namesakeCount(owner, allOwners)` static method that counts owners with a matching (case-insensitive) last name and a *smaller* id, plus a `@Mapping(target = "namesakeCount", ignore = true)` so MapStruct leaves it for explicit computation. Using `id < owner.id` excludes the owner itself and yields the count of *other* owners created before it. Since a new owner always has the largest id, this equals the namesake count at registration and stays stable when read back later (a later namesake has a larger id and is excluded).

3. **Responders** — `RespondWithOwnerCreated`, `RespondWithOwner` (GET), and `RespondWithOwnerUpdated` (PUT) now call `setNamesakeCount(...)`. The GET responder is essential because the `Cp16Tests` create via POST and then read the value back via GET.

The `Cp16Tests` case now passes: the first owner with a fresh surname reports `namesakeCount = 0`, the second reports `1`, and no existing tests regressed.
